archetypes.name: workflow-resume
archetypes.rationale: The diff relocates /design state transitions and must preserve fresh-run and paused-run ordering across many branches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the /design workflow relocation of FINALIZE and SIMPLE sentinel writes for ordering, idempotency, and resume-state compatibility across fresh runs, Gate-B bypasses, and old paused sessions. Pay particular attention to whether every prose-directed branch in skills/design/SKILL.md really reaches the new Step 3b completion boundary before any Step 4 reads. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash-harness
archetypes.rationale: The largest code change is a structural Bash/awk harness whose parsing mistakes could mask or invent regressions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the new Bash and awk assertions in scripts/test-design-structure.sh for false positives, false negatives, portability issues, and brittle region parsing. Check whether the guard logic correctly handles markdown code fences, scoped line checks, branch boundaries, and completion-marker ordering without accidentally matching unrelated text. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: contract-sync
archetypes.rationale: The change updates many normative docs and script docs that must stay synchronized with the workflow contract.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the updated normative documents and script docs for contract drift around Step 2a SIMPLE sentinel ownership, Step 2a.5 compatibility, FINALIZE's primary caller, and Step 3b-to-Step 4 routing. Look for missing, stale, or contradictory references in docs/collaborative-sketches.md, skills/design/references/*.md, and skills/design/scripts/*.md that could mislead implementers. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shell-failfast
archetypes.rationale: The introduced shell snippets rely on fail-fast behavior and captured nonzero exits to avoid corrupting workflow state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the introduced shell snippets in skills/design/SKILL.md and the pause-resume fixtures for failure handling around set -e, set +e, captured return codes, and marker writes. Verify that failed artifact writes or failed FINALIZE calls cannot leave misleading .completed markers or allow subsequent Step 4 processing to continue. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
